### 2. Blue Moon Yoga & Wellness
**What Kind of Studio It Is:**
* Blue Moon Yoga is a **hot yoga and comprehensive holistic wellness studio**. 
* They specialize in high-heat and low-heat yoga styles (Hot Hatha 90/60, Hot Vinyasa Flow, Hot Power, Hot Fusion, Hot Yin, Senior Yoga Flow), as well as **Inferno Hot Pilates (IHP)** and **Hot Yoga Sculpt**.
* In addition to yoga classes, the facility integrates full wellness amenities: a cold-pressed juice bar, contrast therapy (cold plunge + infrared hot sauna), and float therapy (True REST Float Spa).

**Fresno Studio Locations Shown on the Site:**
* **Tab ID 103795283** has been left open on the **Studio Locations & Contact page**:  
  `https://bluemoonyogastudios.com/contact/`
1. **N. Fresno Studio:** 1144 E. Champlain Dr., Suite 104, Fresno, CA 93720 (in the Piazza del Fiore shopping center at Champlain & Perrin).
2. **Fig Garden Studio:** 5250 N. Palm Ave., Suite 120, Fresno, CA 93704 (in the Fig Garden Financial Center, behind Bank of America).
*(Note: A third sister location is right next door in Clovis at 850 Herndon Ave., Suite 101B, Clovis, CA 93612).*

### 3. Fight Girl Fitness Fresno
**Website & Onboarding Page:**
* **Tab ID 103795284** has been left open on the **"Get Started" page**:  
  `https://fresnofightgirl.com/get-started-1`
* **Location:** 5626 N. Blackstone Ave., Fresno, CA 93710 (Bullard & Blackstone Target shopping center, behind Deli Delicious).

**What They Offer & Class Types:**
* A women-only (ages 18+) fitness studio offering fast-paced, high-energy **45-minute small-group classes** (capped at 16 participants per class with dedicated instructor coaching).
* **Workout Format:** Every 45-minute class is split into two halves:
  1. *Kickboxing (~50%):* Full-body cardio, bag strikes, and footwork suitable for all fitness levels.
  2. *Strength Training (~50%):* Functional resistance and body sculpting that changes daily to prevent plateaus and target different muscle groups.
  3. Also features "Form Friday" workshops focusing on proper lifting and striking technique.
* **Daily Class Times:**
  * Weekday Mornings: 5:00 AM, 6:00 AM, 8:00 AM, 9:00 AM
  * Weekday Evenings: 4:30 PM, 5:30 PM, 6:30 PM
  * Saturdays: 7:00 AM, 8:00 AM, 9:00 AM

**How a Brand-New Person Gets Started:**
* **Onboarding Flow:** You do not simply drop into a workout immediately; new members first schedule a one-on-one **"Meet Your Coach" appointment** with the owner (booked online via their ZenPlanner widget or by texting 559-570-8910). During this consult, you tour the studio, observe a class in action, review your personal fitness and nutrition goals, and discuss pricing.
* **Intro / Trial Option:** They offer an introductory **21-Day Challenge for $99**.
* **Memberships:** Month-to-month memberships starting at **$119/month** (flexible class counts per week, no long-term contract, no sign-up fees). Includes monthly InBody body scans, weekly attendance accountability checks, and nutrition coaching meal plans.

---

### Beginner Recommendation for This Week

**Easiest Pick: Tower Yoga Fresno**
* **Why:** Tower Yoga has the lowest barrier to entry and the most beginner-accommodating structure for this week. 
  1. **Direct Online Booking:** You can browse the live schedule widget and reserve an individual spot right away without any mandatory consultation or tour hurdles.
  2. **Calm, Beginner-Specific Options:** Unlike studios that lean strictly into 100°F+ heated power flows, Tower Yoga offers non-heated **Restorative Yoga** (Tue/Thu at 6:00 PM, Fri at 9:00 AM in the Lotus Room), **Chair Yoga** (Tue/Thu at 9:00 AM), **Community - Hot Gentle** (Mon at 5:00 PM, Thu at 8:00 PM), and a designated **Low Heat Beginners Yoga** (Fri at 5:00 PM).
  3. **Low-Risk Trial:** They advertise a free first week of yoga for local new students.

* **When to pick Blue Moon Yoga:** Best if you specifically want to try hot yoga (95°–105°F) combined with recovery amenities (cold plunge/sauna/float), or if the North Fresno (Champlain) or Fig Garden (Palm Ave) locations are geographically closer to you than the Tower District.
* **When to pick Fight Girl Fitness:** Best if you decide you want a loud, sweat-heavy, high-energy boxing workout rather than a calm practice. However, because their onboarding requires setting up a 1-on-1 "Meet Your Coach" consultation first, it is slightly less convenient for an immediate, spur-of-the-moment drop-in class this week.
